diagnosis.symptom: TASK_20260724_067 (run1, commit 0df1187) AND TASK_20260724_079 (run2, commit dc0165b) BOTH trained x1_amp 2000/2000 healthy (reward ~64-71, episode_length ~2000-2230, tracking_lin_vel ~1.0, gait forming) then the task TERMINATED immediately at '[train_eval] evaluating seed=5 ...' with NO report written (data/amp_eval/train_eval_report.json absent) and no per-seed output.
diagnosis.root_cause: train_and_eval.py evaluate() called env.reset_idx(torch.arange(num_envs)) MANUALLY, wrapped in torch.inference_mode(False). reset_idx does inplace index-assignment on gym inference tensors (dof_pos[env_ids]=..., root_states[env_ids]=..., last_actions[env_ids]=0. ...). inference_mode(False) EXITS inference mode, so those inplace updates are illegal -> 'Inplace update to inference tensor outside InferenceMode'. The prior 'fix' (commit 4996384) used inference_mode(False), which is backwards. Evidence: humanoid/envs/base/legged_robot.py reset_idx (lines 219-265), check_termination (206-217); humanoid/algo/amp/amp_on_policy_runner.py rollout wraps env.step in torch.inference_mode() (line 105) where the env's INTERNAL auto-reset (post_physics_step -> reset_idx, line 191) is legal.
diagnosis.why_smoke_play_worked: smoke_amp.py play (Gate-A, verified play=True) used act_inference under torch.no_grad() with NO manual reset_idx -> only the env's internal auto-reset (under the gym inference_mode maintained inside env.step) ran. It never tripped the manual-reset path.

fix.change: (1) eval rollout wrapped in torch.inference_mode() (match training context, NOT inference_mode(False)); (2) rely on env internal auto-reset, NEVER call reset_idx manually; (3) policy = actor_critic.act_inference, fixed vx=0.5 command every step; (4) DR/noise off (nominal dynamics, matches play.py); (5) episode segmentation via reset_buf[0], fall = reset with time_out_buf[0]==False (send_timeouts=True); (6) warm-up episode discarded; (7) hard step_cap prevents hang; (8) per-seed reseed + per-seed try/except; always writes report. py_compile OK.
